rulings.reason: As written the instruction scores the paper's methodological camp -- continuous ODE/PDE derivation gets 10, empirically-validated discrete architectures get 0 -- so a high score is a topic/subfield marker rather than evidence of research quality, and a rigorous, well-evidenced empirical architecture paper would be floored by it. It is mixed because the mathematical grounding it detects does plausibly co-occur with genuine derivational rigor in some submissions.
